title: Unified Document and Panel Orchestration
problem: The legacy workspace persisted layouts but did not bind documents and panels to theme, professional profile, jurisdiction and review state as one recoverable session.
contracts: WorkspaceManager remains the internal document and panel engine
Workspace2SessionAuthority is the single public session authority
recovery envelopes include shell, panel descriptors and workspace state
every envelope is protected by canonical SHA-256
restoration validates the complete candidate before committing state
writes are atomic through same-directory temporary replacement
session save and restore publish observable events
acceptance: failed restoration does not mutate active state
professional_boundary: Session recovery preserves application evidence; it does not validate engineering calculations or professional approval.
next_increment: W2-03 project/BIM browser plus property inspector integration
